comparisons.detail: ADAPTIVE_STATE_ONLY tops out at 0.4754638671875 (best score reachable by ADAPTIVE_STATE_ONLY's allocation set {(0,0) (2,0)} under a perfect signal, with the same items and the same two-unit budget), below JOINT_FROZEN's achieved 0.858154296875; 0.3826904296875 of the 0.39501953125 margin was unreachable before the run, so the comparison measures ADAPTIVE_STATE_ONLY's capability (may allocate (0,0) (2,0); reads s_c) rather than the mechanism

baseline.ceiling_definition: best score reachable by ADAPTIVE_STATE_ONLY's allocation set {(0,0) (2,0)} under a perfect signal, with the same items and the same two-unit budget

winner.ceiling_definition: best score reachable by JOINT_FROZEN's allocation set {(0,0) (1,1) (2,0) (0,2)} under a perfect signal, with the same items and the same two-unit budget

comparisons.detail: ADAPTIVE_REASON_ONLY tops out at 0.463623046875 (best score reachable by ADAPTIVE_REASON_ONLY's allocation set {(0,0) (0,2)} under a perfect signal, with the same items and the same two-unit budget), below JOINT_FROZEN's achieved 0.858154296875; 0.39453125 of the 0.4053955078125 margin was unreachable before the run, so the comparison measures ADAPTIVE_REASON_ONLY's capability (may allocate (0,0) (0,2); reads s_r) rather than the mechanism

baseline.ceiling_definition: best score reachable by ADAPTIVE_REASON_ONLY's allocation set {(0,0) (0,2)} under a perfect signal, with the same items and the same two-unit budget

winner.ceiling_definition: best score reachable by JOINT_FROZEN's allocation set {(0,0) (1,1) (2,0) (0,2)} under a perfect signal, with the same items and the same two-unit budget

scientific_authority.detail: The historical margin is not attributable to reading a second signal because both shipped one-axis baselines have action-set ceilings below the winner's achieved score. Matching the four-action capability flips the registered gate.

successor_requirement: Freeze P12B before outcomes with identical four-action sets for one- and two-signal arms, fixed policies, family/domain-block inference, and an attainable positive gate.
